record.title: Implement pinned passive private-cache observer and controls
record.intent: Turn recovered Setup ownership into a bounded observer with preserved failure evidence.
requirements: Preserve stock originals and predecessor reader contracts. Integrate exact APK/native pins, PID/start-time and boot identity, selected module-map consistency and readable pointer ranges.

Resolve service38 through the pinned registry, exact Setup vtables and backlink. Bound active entries64, capacity128, and two private windows of0x700; declare and enforce a total read budget including owner metadata.

Never attach, invoke target methods, write target memory, acquire target locks or use device IO. Preserve partial/raw samples on rejection. Label repeated observations non-atomic and not device readback.

Build reproducibly and exercise host positive and rejection controls before committing/pushing preparation. If implementation cannot meet the recovered contract, record that limitation without broadening reads.
acceptance: The native observer and deterministic fixture are ready for bounded disposable guest validation.
